---
description: 'Nunjucks guidelines'
applyTo: '**/*.njk'
---

### Front Matter

- [ ] `title`: The title of the post.
- [ ] `permalink`: The permalink URL for the post. It must be unique inside it's folder.
- [ ] `css`: List of CSS files to include for the post. The last files in the list should be of a folder that is named by the folder of the file. The first CSS can be from the folder "basics" or "components"
